name: migration-test-keep-old-ddl
tags: migration test isolation ddl schema inline pre-migration refactor preserve integrity pragma alter table task:cb357eb6
body:
Migration tests must keep the pre-migration DDL inline — never replace it with the canonical (post-migration) DDL from src/db/schema.py, and never refactor it away when updating other tests in the same file to import from schema.py.

**Why:** A test named `test_migration_*` (e.g. `test_migration_backfill_from_tags` in tests/test_task_issue_type.py) exists specifically to exercise an `ALTER TABLE` backfill path. If its schema is replaced with the canonical post-migration DDL, the columns already exist before `migrate_*()` runs, so the migration becomes a no-op and the test passes vacuously without exercising anything (task:cb357eb6).

**How to apply:** Any test that deliberately creates an old schema to test an `ALTER TABLE` migration must build the DB using the old schema manually, then call the prod migrate function — leave it inline even when sibling tests get updated to import from schema.py. A comment like `# intentional: pre-migration schema` is sufficient to mark it.
